Container.Name: mantel
Container.Overview: Mantel, the family wall display: calendars, weather, photos, lists and Home Assistant controls for an iPad or Surface on the wall. One container serves the display and its API on one port and keeps its data in SQLite under /data. Open the WebUI to reach the settings page.
Container.Requires: Home Assistant reachable from this container (its own container with host networking is fine: use http://UNRAID-IP:8123).

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Port the tablets open. Change the left side only if 8787 is taken.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, caches and the Home Assistant allow-list (home.yaml). Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: How the tablets reach this container, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8787 (your Unraid IP and the port above). Used for sign-in redirects.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Household timezone for logs. The screen schedule uses the timezone on the settings page.

Config.Name: Mock mode
Config.Description: 1 shows sample data for everything and skips pairing: handy to check the container works before any accounts are connected. 0 for the real house.

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL
Config.Description: Home Assistant's address as seen from this container. With HA on host networking, use the Unraid IP and port 8123.

Config.Name: Home Assistant token
Config.Description: Long-lived access token from your Home Assistant profile, Security tab.

Config.Name: Home Assistant allow-list
Config.Description: YAML list of the areas and entities the wall may see and control. Lives in the Data folder.

Config.Name: Google client ID
Config.Description: OAuth client (Web application) from Google Cloud Console, for Google Calendar.

Config.Name: Google client secret
Config.Description: The secret for the OAuth client above.

Config.Name: iCloud Apple ID
Config.Description: Apple ID email for iCloud calendars.

Config.Name: iCloud app-specific password
Config.Description: From appleid.apple.com, Sign-In and Security, App-Specific Passwords.

Config.Name: iCloud shared album link
Config.Description: Public Website link of the iCloud Shared Album for the photo slideshow.

Config.Name: Google Routes API key
Config.Description: For leave-by times on weekday mornings. Optional.

Config.Name: Weather alerts contact
Config.Description: An email address; the National Weather Service asks for one with alert requests.
